content:
Extract the invoice data from the document below into JSON with exactly this schema:

{
  "vendor_name": "string",
  "invoice_number": "string",
  "invoice_date": "YYYY-MM-DD",
  "due_date": "YYYY-MM-DD or null if not applicable",
  "currency": "3-letter ISO code",
  "subtotal": 0.00,
  "tax_amount": 0.00,
  "total": 0.00,
  "line_items": [
    {"description": "string", "quantity": 0, "unit_price": 0.00, "amount": 0.00}
  ]
}

Note: subtotal means all pre-tax charges (including shipping and after discounts).

Return only the JSON object, nothing else.

DOCUMENT:
QUILL & SAGE PRINTING LTD.
14 Bishopsgate Mews, London EC2M
VAT Reg: GB 442 8871 09

INVOICE

Invoice ref: QS-25-0287
Date of invoice: 11 February 2025
Terms: 30 days
Currency: GBP (pounds sterling)

Customer: Larkspur Gallery

------------------------------------------------------------------
 JOB DESCRIPTION                    QTY      UNIT PRICE    AMOUNT
------------------------------------------------------------------
 Business cards, 400gsm matte        250       0.0850       21.25
 Flyers A5, full colour             1200       0.0525       63.00
 Posters A1, satin finish             35       4.3330      151.66
------------------------------------------------------------------
                                        Subtotal:          235.91
                                        VAT (6.5% reduced): 15.33
                                        TOTAL:             215.24

Please quote invoice ref on all payments.

```json
{
  "vendor_name": "QUILL & SAGE PRINTING LTD.",
  "invoice_number": "QS-25-0287",
  "invoice_date": "2025-02-11",
  "due_date": "2025-03-13",
  "currency": "GBP",
  "subtotal": 235.91,
  "tax_amount": 15.33,
  "total": 215.24,
  "line_items": [
    {
      "description": "Business cards, 400gsm matte",
      "quantity": 250,
      "unit_price": 0.0850,
      "amount": 21.25
    },
    {
      "description": "Flyers A5, full colour",
      "quantity": 1200,
      "unit_price": 0.0525,
      "amount": 63.00
    },
    {
      "description": "Posters A1, satin finish",
      "quantity": 35,
      "unit_price": 4.3330,
      "amount": 151.66
    }
  ]
}
```
